facts.fact: Woody 冷脸为 Jo 开门，前夜的温柔已凝固成僵硬；Jo 带着不祥预感走进门厅。
facts.anchor: Woody holds open Mimi’s apartment door. Everything tender in his face the night before is now set, hard-etched.

facts.fact: Woody 开门见山：问题不在稿子而在 Jo 本人，是个「大问题」；他也没怎么睡，手抹过未刮的脸颊。
facts.anchor: ‘There’s a problem with you.’ He looks like he hasn’t slept much either, raking a hand down his unshaven cheek. ‘A massive problem.’

facts.fact: Woody 一早复查了 Pamela 的地址并做了调查，起因是昨晚河边 Jo 的脸色。
facts.anchor: ‘I double-checked Pamela’s address first thing and did some digging because … well, your face by the river last night.’

facts.fact: Woody 查出 Jo 七年前登记的住址就是 Mimi 姐妹的地址。
facts.anchor: ‘I found out you were registered as living at Mimi’s sister’s address seven years ago.’

facts.fact: Jo 亲口承认 Pamela 是自己的祖母，并说一直很想告诉他。
facts.anchor: ‘Pamela is my grandmother,’ she says, trying not to crumple into a snivelling heap on the floor.

facts.fact: Jo 快速解释发现经过：铁盒里的旧剪报让她震惊地认出著名 Mimi Mott 就是祖母疏远的姐妹 Miriam。
facts.anchor: So Jo tells him, rapid-fire, about her discovery of old press cuttings in a tin, the shocking realization that the famous Mimi Mott was Granny’s estranged sister, Miriam.

facts.fact: Woody 宣告最后一批文稿已送 Lordats，Jo 与 Mimi 的 sessions 已经结束。
facts.anchor: ‘Jo, the last bit of copy’s gone to Lordats. Your sessions with Mimi are over. Finished.’

facts.fact: 章末 Woody 压低声音发出警告：Mimi 已经知道了。
facts.anchor: He lowers his voice, heavy with warning: ‘Mimi already knows.’
